title: Assistant
feature_description: Ask questions in plain language and get suggestions to approve.
ai_feature_chat_hint: Answers questions with tools that look things up. Its changes are always suggestions. When off, the assistant does not answer.
compose_placeholder: Ask something, or say what to add
failed_not_configured: The AI is not set up yet. An admin can set it up in Settings → AI.
failed_limit_reached: The monthly AI limit is reached.
failed_auth: The AI service refused its key. An admin can check it in Settings → AI.
failed_data_policy: No provider of the chosen AI model met the data rules. An admin can turn off “Only providers that keep no data” in Settings → What the AI may read, or choose another model.
open_ai_privacy: Open What the AI may read
failed_local_required: An area may only use AI on your own network, and the AI chosen is not there.
failed_timeout: The assistant took too long to answer. Try again.
failed_no_answer: The assistant ran out of steps before it could answer. Try a simpler question.
failed_forbidden: You are not allowed to use the assistant.
failed_other: The assistant could not answer. Try again.

example_shopping: Add milk and bread to the shopping list
example_list: What is on the shopping list?
stopped_waiting: You stopped waiting. The answer will appear here when it is ready.
greeting_hint: Ask about the family's day, or tell me what to add.
privacy_line: It sees only what you may see, and its changes wait for approval.
privacy_link_plain: An admin chooses what it may read.
delete_hint: Its messages are gone for good. Changes you already approved stay.
today_block_hint: A link at the bottom to ask a question.
